description: This file defines the class 'FieldOperator' which is part of the SuiteCRM API's JSON:API filtering operators. It extends a base 'Operator' class and implements methods to validate and process filter operator strings, specifically handling operator tags and their formats within the filter system.

classes.name: FieldOperator
classes.description: Represents a filter operator for the JSON:API filtering system, supporting validation and string conversion for operator tags.

methods.name: toFilterTag
methods.description: Converts a string operator to its filter tag representation, delegating to the parent class.

methods.name: isValid
methods.description: Validates whether the given operator string is valid according to the operator format, throwing an exception if the input is not a string.

methods.name: isOperator
methods.description: Checks if a string is a valid operator, with type validation and delegation to 'isValid'.

methods.name: totalOperands
methods.description: Returns the total number of operands expected for this operator, which is zero for this implementation.
